item.title: Self-Hosted TACACS+ Servers: tac_plus vs tac_plus-ng vs tacquito (2026)
item.description: Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus (TACACS+) is a protocol designed for centralized authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) of network devices. Unlike RADIUS which combines authentication and authorization, TACACS+ separates these functions, enabling granular per-command authorization policies — making it the preferred choice for managing router, switch, and firewall access in enterprise networks.
